name: Shadowy Form
body:
School illusion (shadow); Level antipaladin 4, lathspell 4, sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a small square of black cloth)

EFFECT

Range self
Target you
Duration 1 min./level (D)

DESCRIPTION

You envelop your form in shadow, becoming one with it. You gain a +4 bonus on CMD, Escape Artist checks, and Stealth checks. You also gain concealment. These benefits are not thwarted by see invisibility, but true seeing and being in a place of bright light can negate these benefits. Additionally, you gain the compression universal monster ability.
